item.title: Groundhog Loops: A Time-Loop Testbed for Measuring Learning Speed and Tactic Formation in AI Agents
item.description: The project defines a test environment inspired by the time-loop mechanism featured in the film Groundhog Day. item.description: Presbycusis, or age related hearing loss, affects over 430 million individuals worldwide. item.description: ABSTRACT Objective Large Language Models (LLMs) are rapidly transforming artificial intelligence applications, but their unprecedented computational, memory, communication, and data‐management demands pose significant challenges to existing computing infrastructures. item.description: Agent memory architectures define how LLM agents store and reuse experience across tasks, but they are typically fixed after deployment, limiting their adaptability across task types. item.title: Culturally aware comparative evaluation of machine learning and deep learning models for cyberbullying detection
item.description: Introduction The rapid growth of social media has increased the prevalence of cyberbullying, raising serious psychological and social concerns. As abusive language varies across demographic and cultural groups, automated detection systems must be evaluated beyond overall accuracy to assess their effectiveness in identifying culturally sensitive forms of cyberbullying. item.description: Large language model (LLM)-based agents and multi-agent systems increasingly tackle complex tasks through long-horizon tool use and inter-agent collaboration. item.description: Real desktop automation is neither purely visual nor purely programmatic. item.description: The rapid expansion of Internet of Things (IoT) networks has introduced unprecedented connectivity and functionality across domains, but it has also exposed systems to increasingly sophisticated and evolving cyber threats. item.title: Fragmented control, collective risk: multi‐agent AI and the coming governance crisis
item.description: Abstract Multi‐agent artificial intelligence (MAAI) systems are increasingly deployed across economic and digital infrastructures.
